raw_response:
I have only this small shamba, and buying a full bag of fertilizer for it costs too much — that money must go to food and my tablets first. I will put goat manure on it like I always do, and I will plant the seed I saved from last year because it grows even when the rains are short. My grandchildren will help me hoe and weed when they are not in school, but I cannot pay hired workers. I will not waste money on chemicals or irrigation — I have no water pump, and I wait for God to send the rain.
